name: io.github.smangsty/contextforge-unreal
title: ContextForge Unreal
description: Thin ContextForge stdio adapter for Unreal Engine's official local MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CONTEXTFORGE_UNREAL_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional project root used to scope discovered Unreal Editor instances. Bind this to ContextForge's active project root when appropriate.

environmentVariables.name: CONTEXTFORGE_UNREAL_PORT_START
environmentVariables.description: First loopback port to inspect for Unreal Engine MCP servers.

environmentVariables.name: CONTEXTFORGE_UNREAL_PORT_END
environmentVariables.description: Last loopback port to inspect for Unreal Engine MCP servers. The adapter accepts at most 64 ports per range.
